title: Design System: أصحاب الخيمة / Ashab Al Khaimah

display-arabic.purpose: Amiri gathering name; 91px desktop, 77px tablet, 61px mobile and 51px narrow.

headline.purpose: English page title: 42px desktop and 34px mobile; Arabic preserves Amiri treatment.

body-arabic.purpose: IBM Plex Sans Arabic reading and controls.

score.purpose: Lora tabular score fragments, isolated for mixed scripts.

door-name.purpose: Amiri identity at 55px; 45px at 750px and 38px at 380px.

door-change-title.purpose: English Lora heading at 32px / 1.4; recovery and change reuse the established tent-door surfaces.

quran.purpose: Dedicated self-hosted Amiri Quran at 32px/2.6, 28px at 750px. Preserve source text and diacritics.

quran-heading.purpose: Amiri Quran at 35px/1.8, 30px at 750px; dedicated to the shared reading component.

shadows.name: public-panel
shadows.purpose: Red tonal layers, material borders and woven detail provide structure.

shadows.name: lantern-hover-bright
shadows.purpose: Bounded bright-state glow on the inner lantern body; filter settles over 380ms.

shadows.name: tent-door-sheet
shadows.purpose: Soft structural depth below the centered entry sheet.

shadows.name: avatar-small
shadows.purpose: Bounded warm light around the 28px shared portrait.

shadows.name: avatar-account
shadows.purpose: Bounded warm light around the 136px account portrait.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared short control and entry feedback.

motion.name: lantern-sway
motion.purpose: Only the inner bodies sway inside stationary native button targets; pause offscreen, hidden or through the motion control.

motion.name: lantern-light
motion.purpose: Bounded orange halo; static opacity 0.8 with reduced motion.

motion.name: lantern-glass
motion.purpose: Subtle pane brightness synchronized with its halo.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Shared button and utility feedback; pressed scale .98, removed for keyboard/reduced motion.

motion.name: directional-feedback
motion.value: 180ms; translate 2px for options / 3px for action icons
motion.purpose: Fine pointer only; follows reading direction and stops on keyboard focus or reduced motion.

motion.name: progress
motion.purpose: Current and completed quiz segments.

motion.name: navigation-thread
motion.purpose: One measured rail follows selected tab position/width after pointer activation; font/layout resize, RTL and keyboard placement are immediate.

motion.name: question-entry
motion.purpose: Existing quiz question continuity.

motion.name: result-medal
motion.purpose: Single result settle; no confetti.

motion.name: result-score
motion.purpose: Single score settle.

motion.name: motion-access
motion.purpose: Disable animations/transitions and pressed movement; keep content visible. Pause initializes from the existing document setting and survives tent-door entry.

motion.name: lantern-interaction
motion.purpose: Pressed lamp toggles a local orange boost; stationary semantic button remains operable without motion.

motion.name: cushion-breathe
motion.purpose: Inner pixel artwork only; staggered 0/-2/-4/-1s by variant. Shares offscreen/hidden/global pausing with lanterns; static under reduced motion.

motion.name: cushion-hover
motion.purpose: Decorative wrapper feedback for hover-capable pointers; transition removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: avatar-warmth
motion.purpose: Outer portrait ring only; shared ambient pause and static reduced-motion path.

motion.name: heater-coil
motion.purpose: Normal-to-boost coil warmth inside a stationary heater target.

motion.name: heater-halo-spill
motion.purpose: Bounded halo .94 → 1.08 scale; rug spill .8 → 1.12 scaleX. Decoration stays behind content and ignores input.

motion.name: heater-radiance
motion.purpose: Core loop uses only transform/opacity; shared offscreen, hidden, pause and reduced-motion guards.

motion.name: heater-power-light
motion.purpose: Small normal/boost indicator with an immediate static path when motion is disabled.

motion.name: room-warmth
motion.purpose: Faint app rug warmth appears while a heater is boosted; fixed behind content with pointer-events:none.

motion.name: account-unfold
motion.purpose: Pointer disclosure from the trigger-side top corner, mirrored in RTL; keyboard and reduced motion are immediate.

motion.name: tab-scroll-reset
motion.purpose: New tab content commits before scroll reset, preventing stale positions on shorter destinations.

motion.name: study-unfold
motion.purpose: Native study disclosure body opening; reduced motion removes the animation. Chevron uses 160ms and becomes immediate for reduced motion.

layouts.name: student-navigation
layouts.description: Six destinations; three columns by two rows at 750px, 44px minimum targets.

layouts.name: sunday-control
layouts.description: Today on Sunday, otherwise upcoming; native date input, separate full-date mobile grid row and 44px week arrows.

layouts.name: assigned-practice
layouts.description: Locked exact range; one-ayah hidden recall/reveal/listen/finish on clay, wrapping readiness controls.

layouts.name: halaqas
layouts.description: Two equal Lessons / Missed questions sections; quizzes remain visible in context.

layouts.name: public-quran-library
layouts.description: Public tab only: 250px sidebar / flexible reading sheet, 28px gap; native surah disclosure below 1000px. Continuous ivory mushaf with inline 44px green listening buttons. At 750px reading precedes audio; visible Reciter & audio link and loaded fixed native player with 130px bottom allowance.

narrative.overview:
Deep oxblood textile, warm ivory ink and interactive orange lamplight place this bilingual learning circle inside its Najdi gathering. Intricacy comes from an authored geometric Najdi rug, upholstered majlis side rails, Sadu geometry, stepped plaster, fine brass-colored rules, separate pixel-art Sadu cushions and actual Arabic lettering. Generous space around sections, tables and actions makes the dark setting welcoming and readable.

Amiri carries the Arabic identity; Lora gives English headings a quiet literary character. Figtree and IBM Plex Sans Arabic keep controls and reading clear. The muted diamond rug carries the continuous public ground; calm red surfaces carry task content and cards, and clay is reserved for focused reading forms. Reference photographs never appear in the interface.

Individual floor, backrest, square and cylindrical cushion silhouettes add a small crafted accent. A separate pixel-art dish heater shares their stepped geometry and gives the gathering a bounded, interactive source of radiant warmth. Each is hand-drawn crisp-edge SVG; keep them separate and clear of reading and controls. The bilingual remembered-name/password tent door uses the same red, brass, cream fields and lantern vocabulary.
keyCharacteristics: Deep oxblood rug ground with quiet geometric motifs, warm ivory reading and amber actions.
Black, ivory and ochre Sadu, upholstered majlis side rails, stepped plaster and brass detail.
Equal English and Arabic functionality, with RTL and mixed-script isolation.
Stable interactive lantern and dish-heater buttons, bounded orange warmth and fluid control feedback.
Roomy sections, generous table rows and a wider desktop shell.
Separate hand-drawn pixel-art Sadu cushions, never a complete seating scene.

rules.name: The Material Detail Rule
rules.body: Repeat the authored Najdi textile, plaster and brass vocabulary across edges and section details; keep ornament outside reading and control hit areas.

rules.name: The Two Scripts Rule
rules.body: Use Amiri for Arabic display and headings, Lora for English headings, and the language-appropriate sans serif for body and controls. Remove English tracking from Arabic.

rules.name: The Bounded Light Rule
rules.body: Concentrate orange light around lanterns, heater coils and profile portraits; keep any room spill faint and behind readable content. Keep interactive object targets stable. Pause loops offscreen and when the document is hidden; retain the shared pause control and static reduced-motion path.

dos: Do use the four separate authored pixel-art cushion silhouettes at the existing accent placements.
Do use deep red for public grounds, warm ivory for reading and amber for primary actions.
Do reserve clay surfaces for focused reading forms.
Do repeat authored Sadu, stepped plaster and brass details across the public interface.
Do preserve semantic tables, visible keyboard focus, language switching and mixed-script isolation.
Do keep app copy factual and grounded in actual quizzes, standings and approved moments.
Do keep lantern targets stable, keyboard operable and labeled in the current language.
Do keep content visible and interactive before motion starts.
donts: Don't replace the cushions with a composite seating scene, generated illustration or raster asset.
Don't return the public shell to a fully beige or soft light theme.
Don't put reference photographs or raster scene substitutes in the UI.
Don't use sacred text as ornament.
Don't replace the Najdi vocabulary with generic pan-Islamic decoration.
Don't add promotional filler, invented scores, members, dates or quiz content.
Don't propagate legacy blue or purple teacher-control accents into the public design system.
